name: sim_hopf_weyl_pairwise_coupling
scope_note: Pairwise coupling sim (Coupling Program Step 2): Hopf holonomy shell + Weyl chirality shell. Tests holonomy phase survival under L-projection (P1), ordering sensitivity preservation under coupling (P2), L-projector non-commutativity with holonomy (P3). z3 UNSAT: simultaneous triviality impossible on non-trivial loop (N1); coupled admissible set strictly smaller than either shell alone (N2). Boundary: trivial loop (B1) and SU(2) double-cover at Omega=4*pi (B2). Ref: ENGINE_MATH_REFERENCE.md; LADDERS_FENCES_ADMISSION_REFERENCE.md.

pytorch.reason: no automatic differentiation or tensor computation required in this probe

pyg.reason: graph message passing not relevant to spinor/holonomy coupling test

z3.reason: UNSAT guards: (N1) proves no assignment satisfies both shells trivial on non-trivial loop; (N2) proves coupled admissible set strictly smaller than either shell alone — load-bearing for both negative tests

cvc5.reason: z3 sufficient for all separability and product-form UNSAT proofs in this sim

sympy.reason: Analytic holonomy formula verification: exp(i*Omega/2) symbolically; confirms numeric clifford result matches closed-form expression

clifford.reason: Cl(3) rotor holonomy computation and Weyl grade projectors; coupled action on spinors: holonomy rotor applied before/after L-projection; grade decomposition of coupled output states — load-bearing for P1/P2/P3/B1/B2

geomstats.reason: S2 loop construction and solid angle computation; provides geometric Omega values feeding clifford holonomy rotors — load-bearing for loop geometry

e3nn.reason: SO(3) irrep labeling not needed for pairwise coupling test; covered in shell-local sim

rustworkx.reason: no graph traversal or path computation required in this probe

toponetx.reason: no chain complex or cell complex computation required in this probe

gudhi.reason: persistent homology not applicable to holonomy/spinor coupling

geomstats_solid_angle_agrees.note: geomstats S2 metric gives same solid angle as 2*pi*(1-cos(theta))

P1_sympy_holonomy_crosscheck.note: sympy exp(i*Omega/2) matches clifford rotor components

P2_ordering_sensitivity_preserved.note: Hopf-then-Weyl vs Weyl-then-Hopf give distinguishably different outputs; coupling preserves ordering sensitivity from both shells

P3_L_projector_does_not_commute_with_hol.note: P_L does not commute with Hol multiplication: P_L(Hol*s) ≠ Hol*P_L(s) because Hol has grade-2 (e12) component that mixes grades under left action

P2_ordering_difference_consistent_across.note: ordering sensitivity is non-zero for all non-trivial loop sizes tested

N1_z3_unsat_simultaneous_triviality.note: UNSAT: sin_half != 0 (non-trivial loop) directly contradicts Hopf trivial condition sin_half = 0; both shells cannot simultaneously be identity on a non-trivial loop — structural impossibility proven

N2_weyl_alone_admits_pure_grade2.note: SAT: Weyl shell alone admits pure grade-2 spinors (a0=0, a2!=0)

N2_z3_unsat_pure_grade2_excluded_from_co.note: UNSAT: a0=0 AND sin_half*a0 != 0 is impossible; pure grade-2 spinors are Weyl-alone admissible but excluded from the coupled distinguishable set — coupling strictly restricts admissible states

N2_hopf_alone_admits_zero_a0.note: SAT: Hopf shell alone admits a0=0 spinors (loop non-trivial, no grade constraint)

B1_trivial_loop_orderings_agree.note: Omega=0: identity holonomy makes both orderings trivially equivalent

B1_weyl_reduces_grade_independently.note: Omega=0: Weyl-L projection still eliminates grade-2 content; both shells degenerate independently (holonomy trivial, grade reduced)

B2_su2_sign_flip_at_2pi_loop.note: Omega=2*pi (half sphere): SU(2) holonomy = -1 (the non-trivial double-cover element); scalar=-1, e12=0 confirms -I in SU(2)

B2_su2_identity_return_at_4pi_loop.note: Omega=4*pi (full sphere): SU(2) holonomy = +1 (identity); double cover requires 4*pi not 2*pi to return to identity

B2_su2_sign_preserved_under_weyl_at_2pi.note: Omega=2*pi: both orderings preserve the SU(2) -1 sign in the grade-0 output; Weyl coupling does NOT erase the SU(2) double-cover sign

B2_orderings_agree_at_2pi_loop.note: At Omega=2*pi: Hol=-1 (scalar), so Hol*P_L(s) = -P_L(s) AND P_L(Hol*s) = P_L(-s) = -P_L(s); orderings agree when holonomy is a pure scalar (no grade mixing)

B2_geomstats_south_pole_solid_angle_is_4.note: geomstats confirms: south pole loop (theta=pi) encloses full sphere solid angle 4*pi
